- Lab 6: User & Task Management API
  - CRUD Task: title, description, status (TODO/IN_PROGRESS/DONE), priority, dueDate

title: - Lab 6: User & Task Management API
summary: Lab 6 - User & Task Management API: CRUD Task (title/description/status/priority/dueDate) voi @RequestMapping/@PathVariable, validation co ban (title notBlank, dueDate future) ket hop custom validator @ValidStatusTransition (validate cap class kiem tra chuyen trang thai hop le), va global exception handler tra ve ProblemDetail.
prerequisites: Da hoc Day 16 (controller/mapping/ResponseEntity) va Day 17 (Bean Validation, custom validator, @RestControllerAdvice, ProblemDetail).
outcomes: Xay dung day du CRUD endpoint cho Task voi mapping/path variable dung quy uoc da hoc.
Ket hop Bean Validation co ban voi mot custom validator cap class cho logic nghiep vu rieng (chuyen trang thai).
Tap trung xu ly loi bang @RestControllerAdvice tra ve ProblemDetail nhat quan.
Mo ta duoc quy trinh xuat Postman collection de chia se/kiem thu API.

TaskController dung @RequestMapping cap class ('/api/tasks') va cac shortcut theo HTTP method (@GetMapping/@PostMapping/@PutMapping) cho tung thao tac CRUD; bien path {id} duoc bat qua @PathVariable, rang buoc {id:[\d]+} de chi khop id dang so, tuong tu mau da hoc o Day 16.

blocks.text: Rang buoc co ban title notBlank (@NotBlank) va dueDate phai o tuong lai (@Future) dung annotation Bean Validation chuan cua jakarta.validation.constraints; hai annotation nay khong co resource nao trong resourceIds cua rieng Day 18 mo ta (chung thuoc resourceIds cua Day 17, noi Bean Validation co ban da duoc trich dan day du) - Day 18 tap trung trich dan phan validate cap class va ProblemDetail, la phan moi so voi Day 17.

Mot constraint tuy chinh duoc dinh nghia bang @interface gan @Constraint(validatedBy = ...Validator.class); lop validator implement ConstraintValidator<Annotation, KieuDuLieu> va override isValid(value, context). @ValidStatusTransition ap dung tuong tu: gan @Target(TYPE) de constraint co the doc dong thoi ca currentStatus va status tu cung mot request, roi kiem tra chuyen trang thai co nam trong tap chuyen hop le hay khong (TODO -> IN_PROGRESS -> DONE, cho phep lui IN_PROGRESS -> TODO, khong cho chuyen tiep tu DONE).

blocks.partialReason: Minh hoa cach dung Spring/Jakarta API; khong bien dich doc lap duoc vi moi truong javac --release 17 cua pipeline nay khong co Spring Framework/Jakarta jar tren classpath (chi co JDK chuan).

blocks.text: TaskExceptionHandler la mot @RestControllerAdvice tap trung xu ly loi cho toan bo TaskController: dung ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(status, message) de dung phan hoi loi thong nhat (type/title/status/detail/instance) thay vi tu dinh nghia cau truc JSON loi rieng cho tung truong hop, ap dung dung mau da hoc o Day 17.

blocks.text: Yeu cau xuat Postman collection khong co resource nao trong resourceIds cua Day 18 mo ta (xem authoring.limitations). Cach lam pho bien: goi thu tung endpoint CRUD Task trong Postman, gom cac request lai thanh mot Collection, dung tinh nang 'Export' cua Postman de xuat file .json chua toan bo request/vi du response, luu kem repository de nhom khac/CI co the import lai va chay smoke test.

commonMistakes: Gan @ValidStatusTransition o @Target(FIELD) khien validator khong doc duoc ca hai field can so sanh.
Quen xu ly TaskNotFoundException trong @RestControllerAdvice, de loi 500 mac dinh lo ra ngoai thay vi ProblemDetail 404 ro rang.
Cho phep chuyen trang thai tuy y (vi du DONE -> TODO) ma khong kiem tra qua ALLOWED map.

practices.prompt: Theo StatusTransitionValidator trong bai, chuyen trang thai nao duoi day la KHONG hop le?
practices.hint: Xem lai bang ALLOWED trong StatusTransitionValidator.
practices.explanation: Trong ALLOWED map cua vi du, TaskStatus.DONE anh xa toi Set.of() (tap rong) - nghia la tu DONE khong duoc phep chuyen sang bat ky trang thai nao khac, nen DONE -> IN_PROGRESS la khong hop le.
practices.rubric: Doi chieu tung lua chon voi Map ALLOWED trong code vi du; danh gia dung neu nhan ra DONE la trang thai cuoi (khong co chuyen tiep hop le).

practices.prompt: Them mot @GetMapping('') tren TaskController tra ve ResponseEntity<List<Task>> toan bo task, tuong tu mau search o Day 16.
practices.hint: Dung @GetMapping khong tham so, goi repository.findAll(), boc trong ResponseEntity.ok().
practices.explanation: Ap dung lai mau ResponseEntity.ok(...) da hoc o Day 16 vao TaskController.
practices.rubric: Danh gia dung: co @GetMapping cap class, tra ResponseEntity.ok voi danh sach Task.

practices.prompt: Vi sao @ValidStatusTransition duoc gan @Target(ElementType.TYPE) thay vi @Target(ElementType.FIELD) nhu @ValidPhoneNumber o Day 17?
practices.hint: So sanh so field ma constraint can doc de kiem tra.
practices.solution: Vi constraint can doc dong thoi hai field (currentStatus va status) tu cung mot doi tuong StatusUpdateRequest de so sanh chuyen trang thai co hop le hay khong; @Target(FIELD) chi cho phep validator xet gia tri cua mot field don le, khong du de kiem tra quan he giua hai field.
practices.explanation: Lien ket voi ly do dung @Target(TYPE) cho validate cap class da hoc o Day 17.
practices.rubric: Danh gia hoc vien neu dung ly do can doc nhieu field cung luc.

practices.prompt: TaskExceptionHandler nen tra ve HTTP status nao cho TaskNotFoundException va vi sao dung ProblemDetail thay vi tu dinh nghia mot Map loi rieng?
practices.hint: Xem lai code handleNotFound trong bai va ly do dung ProblemDetail chuan hoa.
practices.solution: Nen tra ve HTTP 404 (NOT_FOUND), dung ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ex.getMessage()) de dam bao cau truc loi (type/title/status/detail/instance) thong nhat voi cac loi khac trong cung API, thay vi moi loai loi lai co mot dinh dang JSON rieng gay kho cho client xu ly.
practices.explanation: Ket noi voi HTTP status 404 chuan cho 'khong tim thay tai nguyen' va loi ich chuan hoa cua ProblemDetail.
practices.rubric: Danh gia dung ca hai y: status 404 va ly do chon ProblemDetail (nhat quan cau truc loi).

limitations: @NotBlank/@Future tren TaskRequest (day18-blk-3): TaskRequest dung cac annotation Bean Validation co ban ma chi thuoc resourceIds cua Day 17 (res-1f904f56cc5a) - de thoa man rule code block phai co citation, day18-blk-3 duoc gan citation c3 (res-7f4116f00d7f, Bean Validation annotation definition) vi cung nam trong resourceIds cua Day 18 va la nguon Bean Validation gan nhat; @NotBlank/@Future la built-in constraint, c3 tap trung custom validator, nen trich dan nay la 'gan nhat co the' - Day 17 (res-1f904f56cc5a) moi co phan trich dan day du ve @NotBlank/@Future.
